review-days.why: Two weeks: a project that nobody has looked at for a fortnight is worth a second look, and it is the number the Freshness filter always used.

gantt-editor.why: A project has no Gantt tab until someone asks for one, so the tab bar stays as short as before.

gantt-client.why: Nothing reaches a client's report until the editor chooses it.

gantt-name.why: The word the tab was always called.
